title: Scenario runner: --lang zh|en and --prompt short|detailed choose the build prompt the agent is given
body:
epic:#33595#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qiby1cctpVpRbJzjccvY

Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed child of #33595 (M2 row of its milestone table). Maintainer, 2026-11-15 02:10Z: 「你建议的任务全部立卡，你负责开 devx 车道派发处理」; 08:36Z, on the epic seat's decision card "M2/M3 的行现在立卡吗?立了交给谁派发?": "立卡,留给本专题席位派发".

## Mechanism

`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/prompts.ts` renders every card text through `text = (t) => t.en ?? t.zh ?? ''` (~52), so a card with both languages is always given in English. `buildPrompt` (~351) always uses `card.prompt.detailed`; `card.prompt.short` is never sent. `runner/cli.ts` has neither flag.

## Why it matters

Customers will prompt the platform in Chinese and in a sentence, not in a detailed English brief. The eval on #33595 measures only the most favourable input, so it cannot tell how a model does on the prompts real users write. M3's Chinese prompts for the control cards depend on the runner being able to send them.

## Done when

- `--lang zh|en` picks the language every prompt is rendered in (build, iterate, question, operation), with no silent fallback: a card missing a field in the asked language is reported and not run in that language.
- `--prompt short|detailed` picks the card's prompt for the build turn (default `detailed`, so today's output is unchanged).
- The scorecard and run record state both choices.
- Tests pin the rendered prompt for each combination on one card and the refusal for a missing language.

## Reader

The epic seat `epic:#33595#1` dispatches it to `os-dev` (`domain:devx`, `packages/qa/scenarios`), serial with the other M2 runner cards where files overlap.

Dedup: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue "--lang" scenarios` → 3 hits (#22146 and #6015 closed and unrelated; #33595 the parent).
